name: 19 Mayıs Tunnel
facts: The 19 Mayıs Tunnel features twin tubes, one 280 meters and the other 260 meters long, each carrying two lanes of traffic in opposite directions.
Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan officially opened the 19 Mayıs Tunnel on February 15, 2009, marking a milestone for Turkey's highway infrastructure.
Positioned between the 845–923 meter Havza Tunnel to the north and the 392-meter Şehzadeler Tunnel to the south, the 19 Mayıs Tunnel sits on the Samsun-Çorum D.795 E95 corridor.
